sin-code --help
cmp stdout help.golden

-- help.golden --
SIN-Code — verification-first coding agent

Every completed task passes a verification gate (PoC/Oracle proof)
before reporting success. 54+ MCP tools, multi-agent orchestration,
session management, and a beautiful TUI.

Usage:
  sin-code [command]
  sin-code [flags]                  Launch chat (interactive TUI or REPL)
  sin-code chat -p "prompt"         Headless one-shot
  sin-code chat -p "prompt" --json  JSON output

Chat & Agent:
  chat                 Run the SIN-Code agent loop (interactive REPL or headless one-shot)
  sessions             Manage persisted agent sessions
  mcp                  Inspect and debug external MCP servers
  tool-search          Debug tool relevance ranking
  goal                 Manage the autonomous goal queue
  daemon               Run the autonomous worker: lease goals, execute, verify, learn
  skill                Manage ecosystem skills from upstream repos (install, status, update)
  skills               Manage bundled project-local skills embedded in the binary (install, list)
  swarm                Race N agent profiles on the same prompt (first verified wins)

Analysis & Verification:
  discover             Discover files with relevance scoring and pattern matching
  execute              Execute shell commands safely with secret redaction and timeout
  map                  Map code architecture with dependency graphs and hot-path analysis
  grasp                Deep code understanding for a single file
  scout                Search code with regex, semantic, symbol, and usage search
  harvest              Fetch URLs with caching, structure extraction, and change detection
  orchestrate          Legacy task manager (use 'sin-code todo' for the SOTA issue tracker)
  ibd                  Intent-Based Diffing — compare code changes against stated intent
  poc                  Proof-of-Correctness — verify code satisfies its specification
  sckg                 Semantic Codebase Knowledge Graphs — build & query code graph
  adw                  Architectural Debt Watchdogs — detect god modules, circular deps, etc.
  oracle               Verify that a source file has corresponding test coverage
  efm                  Ephemeral Full-Stack Mocking — spin up disposable test environments

Code Quality:
  audit                Repo-wide audits (complexity, ...)
  ceo-audit            CEO-grade SOTA repository audit (48 gates)
  review               Review code for complexity and other quality dimensions
  debt                 Inspect sin-debt markers (issue #177)
  compress             Lossless compaction for lessons / instincts / summaries / AGENTS.md
  diff                 Git diff with complexity + sin-debt overlay
  benchmark            Run eval golden datasets and produce a scoring report
  cover                Coverage scanner and test-generation coordinator

Security:
  security             Fast security analysis — auto-detects project type and runs available tools
  sbom                 Generate SPDX or CycloneDX JSON SBOM for a project
  tokens               Inspect LLM token usage (per session, day, lifetime, model)
  permission           Reactive permission engine utilities

Configuration & Setup:
  config               View and manage sin-code configuration
  doctor               Run a unified health check of the entire SIN-Code installation
  status               Print a readiness snapshot of the local SIN-Code state
  stack                Manage the DOX + Superpowers + Vane methodology stack
  install              Install or verify the sin-code single-binary release
  update               Update SIN-Code stack (Python packages, Go binaries, skills)
  self-update          Check for and install the latest sin-code release
  profile              Render & verify the single-source-of-truth agent profile (issue #175)

Ecosystem:
  hub                  Tool catalog and landing page for sin-code
  ledger               Query the semantic session ledger
  summary              Build a deterministic summary from the session ledger
  catalog              Unified tool catalog (hub + assets, one CLI)
  gh                   Bridge to the GitHub CLI (gh) with a 3-tier verb-allowlist policy
  vane                 Bridge to a self-hosted Vane answering engine (citation-backed research)
  superpowers          Integrate obra/superpowers skills into SIN-Code
  dox                  Self-maintaining AGENTS.md hierarchy (agent0ai/dox protocol)
  fusion               SIN Fusion - status, config, benchmarking, model selection
  research             Autonomous research-report generation (issue #384)
  headroom             Manage Headroom context compression integration
  autodev              Bridge to OpenSIN-Code/autodev-cli (Python autoresearch loop, never vendored)

Frontend:
  serve                Start an MCP server exposing all 54+ sin-code tools
  tui                  Interactive multi-pane TUI (Tools, Sessions, EFM, Config, History)
  webui                Start the sin-code web UI server

Lifecycle & Memory:
  todo                 Issue tracker with dependencies, audit log, and project namespaces
  notifications        Manage sin-code todo notifications
  memory               Long-term project memory with semantic search
  assets               Manage harvested agents/commands/skills
  hooks                Inspect and test lifecycle hooks
  eval                 Run Golden Dataset evaluation suites
  trace                Configure + verify OpenTelemetry tracer setup
  evalset              Eval-driven development harness (EvalSets, Runs, regression compare)
  instinct             Manage learned instincts (continuous learning)
  prp                  Product Requirement Prompt workflow (plan→implement→verify→pr)

Utility:
  read                 Read files with hashline anchors, outline, and size guards
  write                Write files atomically with syntax pre-validation
  edit                 Hashline-anchored surgical edits with validation
  lsp                  LSP (Language Server Protocol) — IDE-grade code intelligence
  plugin               Manage user-installed plugins (subcommands, agents, tools, hooks)
  index                Manage persistent incremental code index
  rules                Path-scoped rule loader (.sin-code/rules/<topic>.md)
  checkpoint           Snapshot the current workspace state
  rewind               Restore the workspace to a prior checkpoint
  image-graph          Generate SOTA charts (bar, line, pie, area) as HTML + PNG
  analyse              Passive bridge shell for the sin-analyse-suite Python MCP (read-only)
  analyse-image        Analyze an image with a vision-capable LLM (no Tesseract)
  auto                 Ultra-autonomous mode: pursue a program.md objective on your behalf

Advanced:
  codegraph            Bridge to CodeGraph for multi-language code analysis
  spec                 Author, validate & inspect *.spec.md contracts (Spec-Layer)
  triage               Read the open issue backlog via gh, score, group, and render
  grill                Native adversarial design-review interview (issue #141 fusion)
  subagent             Run a subtask in an isolated session, return summary (issue #192)
  autopr               Self-healing pipeline: auto-fix trivial regressions and open a PR
  compile-spec         Compile .sin-code.yml into the four derived JSON artifacts
  rtk                  Bridge to rtk (Rust Token Killer) to cut LLM token usage 60-90%
  orchestrator-run     Run a prompt through the multi-agent orchestrator (Pre-LLM router → planner → parallel agents)
  orchestrator-agents  List available agents (default + user-defined + plugin)
  orchestrator-plan    Build a plan from a prompt (no execution)

Other:
  completion           Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for sin-code
  -v, --version   version for sin-code

Run 'sin-code <command> --help' for command-specific help.
Run 'sin-code' (no args) to start chatting.
